name: Sail rides
description: Sail is a ride-hailing aggregator that allows users to compare prices and availability across different transport services to find the most affordable and efficient ride.

founders.name: Aikins Laryea
founders.bio: Aikins Laryea is a full-stack engineer building the ultimate ride-hailing and delivery aggregator in West Africa. He believes in validating product demand through early design posts on X and LinkedIn.

longDescription: Sail rides is a leading ride-hailing aggregator operating in Accra, Ghana. It brings transparency and efficiency to the local transportation ecosystem by allowing commuters to compare ride costs, arrival times, and services across multiple platforms simultaneously. Users save money and find the fastest rides, while drivers benefit from optimized demand distribution.

name: Reveal Real Estate
description: We help you invest in real estate with full transparency, expert guidance, and end-to-end support. Secure your dream property without the hassle.

founders.name: Hannah Lormenyo
founders.bio: Hannah founded Reveal Real Estate to help individuals and diaspora investors securely invest in Ghanaian property through land verification, construction oversight, and end-to-end project management.

name: Pouch
description: pouch provides the contactless apple pay experience, using mobile money.

founders.name: Kweku Ayepah
founders.bio: Kweku is building a contactless Apple Pay-like experience using mobile money in Ghana, bringing NFC-powered tap-to-pay to the local payments ecosystem.

name: Chime
description: A high-visibility productivity tool for macOS designed to ensure users never miss meetings by replacing subtle notifications with unmissable alerts.

founders.name: Derrick Tsorme
founders.bio: Derrick is a Design Engineer and indie maker who builds and ships macOS desktop utilities. He created Chime to replace subtle meeting notifications with full-screen, unmissable alerts.

name: RateCardly
description: A professional platform that allows creators and freelancers to build and share digital, link-based rate cards for their services and pricing.

founders.name: Theophilus Arthur
founders.bio: Theophilus is a product designer building digital link-based rate cards for creators and freelancers. He focuses on capturing value early and testing iterations with active community builders.

name: Echolift
description: A technology platform that simplifies the donation process by connecting donors directly with verified charities through a decentralized system.

founders.name: Chisom Nwankwo
founders.bio: Chisom is a software engineer building decentralized donation channels for verified charities. He scaled Echolift's volunteer community across engineering, product, and design.

name: JamPolls
description: An audience engagement and polling platform designed for creators and brands to gather instant feedback through highly shareable, Gen Z-friendly polls.

founders.name: Charles Kojo Peprah
founders.bio: Charles is a product engineer building interactive polling widgets for creators and brands. He focuses on building audience intelligence tools that find traction in politics and media.

name: Beeterty
description: A professional invoicing and financial management platform that helps African freelancers create branded invoices and track payments.

founders.name: Yoofi Graham
founders.bio: Yoofi is a software developer building payment and invoicing tools for African freelancers. He advocates for launching early to gather immediate feedback.

name: The Skill Club
description: A career-focused community and talent marketplace that connects students and tech-savvy individuals in Ghana with internships and masterclasses.

founders.name: Sedem Balfour
founders.bio: Sedem is an ecosystem builder who previously served as Ecosystem Manager at Hacklab Foundation and Startup Grind Chapter Director for KNUST. He founded Skill Club to bridge the gap between African talent and startups through high-touch, manual matching.

name: GiftPal
description: An online gift registry and management platform that helps individuals and groups coordinate gift lists for occasions like weddings or holidays.

founders.name: Nicholas Mamiya
founders.bio: Nicholas is a software engineer and cloud architect who built GiftPal as gifting infrastructure for brands and platforms, enabling loyalty cards, bulk gifting campaigns, and embeddable APIs.

name: FitSynQ
description: A comprehensive gym management 'operating system' that automates member check-ins, multi-location billing, and class bookings.

founders.name: Selorm Foli
founders.bio: Selorm is a software engineer building gym management software to replace clipboards, WhatsApp groups, and spreadsheets with a centralized digital dashboard for fitness businesses in Ghana.

name: BuukMeNow
description: A service discovery and appointment booking platform that connects users with local professionals in beauty, healthcare, and grooming.

founders.name: Peter Onisha Peregbakumo
founders.bio: Peter is a software engineer building booking and scheduling infrastructure for service-based businesses in Ghana.

founders.name: Michael Sarpong
founders.bio: Michael oversees operations at BuukMeNow, driving adoption among student entrepreneurs and small businesses across Ghanaian universities.

name: GatePass
description: A streamlined event ticketing platform that allows organizers to create events and sell digital tickets with secure QR codes for paperless entry.

founders.name: Samuel Allotey
founders.bio: Samuel is a designer and community organizer building paperless QR-based event check-in systems and coordinating the FiDCon conference.

founders.name: Maxwell Cofie
founders.bio: Maxwell is a builder and community architect behind Sandbox Réseau. He co-founded GatePass to simplify event ticketing and gate entry for organizers in Accra.

name: Golly Express
description: An international shipping and package forwarding platform that allows users to shop from global retailers and have their packages delivered locally.

founders.name: Solomon Opoku
founders.bio: Solomon (Soulpee) is a software engineer building cross-border e-commerce and freight forwarding infrastructure, making international shopping accessible to Ghanaians.

name: Thedsgnjunkies
description: An African creative community that empowers designers through mentorship, campus tours, and conferences like FiDCon.

founders.name: Samuel Allotey
founders.bio: Samuel is a designer and community organizer building platform tools for African creatives and coordinating the FiDCon conference.

name: Clerra
description: An AI-powered legal practice management platform with case tracking, billing automation, document insights, and fast legal research — all in one place.

founders.name: Richmond Agbavor
founders.bio: Richmond is a product designer building an AI-native legal case management OS. He validates features using mockups to get lawyers' payment intent before coding.

name: OpenProp Africa
description: A property and home essentials marketplace in Ghana. Buy, rent, or sell property, shop furniture and appliances, and book moving, cleaning, and home services.

founders.name: Joseph Mensah
founders.bio: Joseph is a software engineer building digital home discovery platforms in Ghana. He leverages high-fidelity virtual tours and end-to-end move-in infrastructure.

name: Night Market
description: A local commerce platform that brings your favorite neighborhood vendors online — order from the Night Market and get it delivered in minutes.

founders.name: Harold Benji
founders.bio: Harold is a software builder creating digital trade networks for night vendors in Accra. He validates ideas by identifying real manual workarounds before building code.

name: NewComma
description: A social recruitment platform connecting creative talent across Africa and its diaspora with jobs, grants, and resources. Build your portfolio and grow your network.

founders.name: Natalie Narh
founders.bio: Natalie is an award-winning creative director and advocate for spotlighting African creative talent globally.

founders.name: Nigel Atta-Mensah
founders.bio: Nigel is an operations leader building recruitment networks for African creative talent.

name: Budge AI
description: An AI-powered expense tracker that auto-syncs transactions from SMS and email, giving users real-time visibility into their spending without manual entry.

founders.name: Andrew Glago
founders.bio: Andrew is a software engineer building personal finance tools for African users. He pivoted Budge AI to push notifications and SMS parsing when banking APIs proved unreliable.

name: Gaderin
description: A curated experiences marketplace for Accra — discover and book activities, cultural events, food tours, art, and adventures hosted by locals.

founders.name: Cornelius Owusu-Ansah
founders.bio: Cornelius is a software engineer and designer building curated experiences for the African creative class. He shares how a sudden surge of social media word-of-mouth test-stresses tech products.

name: Kixara
description: An e-commerce and marketing platform that lets businesses launch online stores and send bulk WhatsApp campaigns to thousands of contacts.

founders.name: Joycelyn Otchere
founders.bio: Joycelyn is a Business Intelligence Analyst and speaker at the Girls in Technology Summit. She co-founded Kixara to enable African businesses to sell online and reach customers via WhatsApp.

name: Piply
description: An AI study workspace for students that turns notes into flashcards, quizzes, and mind maps instantly — study smarter, retain more, and show up ready for exams.

founders.name: Andrews Boateng
founders.bio: Andrews is building an AI-powered study platform that helps students organize course materials, create quizzes and flashcards, and plan focused study sessions with active recall techniques.

name: PastCare
description: A comprehensive church management platform for tracking members, attendance, donations, and events — designed for modern congregations with a free plan available.

founders.name: Reuben Frimpong
founders.bio: Reuben is a software engineer building church management portals. He started development during the 2020 pandemic to automate member communication and attendance.

name: Aldin Cycles
description: Ghana's first bike-sharing company — providing affordable, eco-friendly urban mobility through a network of shared bicycles across the city.

founders.name: Husamal Din Kofi Ahmed
founders.bio: Husamal co-founded Aldin Cycles in 2023 to provide sustainable, affordable micro-mobility on university campuses in Ghana, starting at the University of Ghana, Legon.

founders.name: Rene Atiso
founders.bio: Rene oversees marketing and operations at Aldin Cycles, scaling the campus bike-sharing fleet of standard and electric bicycles across Ghanaian universities.

name: SusuPaa
description: A digital savings management platform that modernizes the traditional West African 'susu' system — helping groups and institutions manage collective savings securely.

founders.name: Emmanuel Yeboah
founders.bio: Emmanuel is a software engineer building fintech infrastructure to digitize Ghana's traditional rotational susu savings system, automating contributions, reminders, and member management.

name: Krom
description: A carpooling platform connecting drivers and passengers traveling the same routes across Ghana — affordable rides, split costs, verified profiles, and secure payments.

founders.name: Kobe Kwarteng
founders.bio: Kobe is building Ghana's inter-city carpooling network, connecting drivers and passengers along shared routes with verified profiles, in-app payments, and fair cost splitting.

name: Mande
description: An AI-powered career companion for students that provides career readiness scores, personalized career matching, and 24/7 support to turn degrees into careers.

founders.name: Joel Anaman
founders.bio: Joel is a career coach and product manager who founded Mande to automate career readiness for African students and graduates. A pharmacist turned tech builder, he was selected for the Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub in 2023.

longDescription: Mande is an AI-powered career companion designed specifically for students and recent graduates in Ghana. By offering career readiness scores, personalized job and internship matching, and 24/7 career guidance, Mande helps bridge the gap between classroom education and professional careers. The platform assists students in building premium resumes, practicing interview skills, and understanding their unique skills and fit.

name: Trip o'clock
description: An AI-powered travel companion that helps you plan trips, find accommodations, book flights, get global e-SIMs, and discover destinations — all in one place.

founders.name: Hope Adoli
founders.bio: Hope is a UX designer and product builder focused on travel technology. She co-founded Mizormor to make travel planning across Africa seamless and accessible.

founders.name: Peter Sowah
founders.bio: Peter is a software engineer building the technical infrastructure behind Trip o'clock. He leads development of the AI-powered itinerary engine and eSIM integration.

longDescription: Trip o'clock is an AI-powered travel planner that simplifies the journey from destination discovery to final booking. The platform integrates personalized itinerary generation, flight and hotel comparison, global e-SIM delivery, and activities recommendations into a single, cohesive travel companion. Ideal for modern travelers exploring the continent and beyond.

name: Traaple
description: A discovery and booking platform reshaping the experience economy — connecting people to cultural activities, lifestyle services, events, entertainment, and everyday essentials.

founders.name: Selase Kove-Seyram
founders.bio: Selase is a journalist, documentary filmmaker, and 2022 Nieman Fellow at Harvard. He founded Traaple after observing that travel information in Africa is fragmented and difficult for travelers to navigate.

longDescription: Traaple is an experience discovery and booking marketplace focused on the African continent. Reshaping the experience economy, Traaple connects locals and travelers alike to unique cultural activities, local entertainment, lifestyle events, and host-led excursions across Ghana. It offers creators and experience hosts the tools to schedule, promote, and monetize their offerings effortlessly.

name: Seesail
description: An embedded finance platform that gives small businesses the same visibility, financing, and distribution power as enterprises — with AI-powered tools for smarter operations.

founders.name: Victor Blavo
founders.bio: Victor is a product design and engineering leader who previously served as Product Design Manager at Chipper Cash. He founded Seesail to give African SMBs enterprise-grade financial visibility and payment tools.

longDescription: Seesail is an embedded finance platform that empowers African small and medium businesses (SMBs) with enterprise-grade financial visibility, cash flow management, and capital distribution tools. By integrating directly into existing workflows and utilizing AI-driven credit scoring, Seesail makes it easy for businesses to manage their resources and access flexible financing.

name: Syio Labs
description: Helping tech startups build global products that shape the world through UI/UX design, branding, and development.

founders.name: John St. Aïmond Banson
founders.bio: John (blarckat) is a product designer and startup builder. He founded Syio Labs to help early-stage startups navigate the 0→1 phase through world-class branding, UI/UX design, and product validation.

longDescription: Syio Labs is a premium design studio and product validation partner based in Accra, Ghana. Specializing in helping tech startups achieve product-market fit, Syio Labs provides high-fidelity UI/UX design, comprehensive design systems, cohesive brand identity, and front-end development. The studio is dedicated to turning complex technical concepts into immersive, user-friendly digital experiences that stand out.

name: Rivia Clinics
description: A multi-specialty clinic chain offering comprehensive employee healthcare through a single annual fee — with virtual care, pharmacy, lab, and specialist services across Ghana.

founders.name: Isidore Kpotufe
founders.bio: Isidore Kpotufe is a serial entrepreneur reshaping primary healthcare in Ghana. He previously founded the bus-sharing startup Stabus (acquired by Treepz) and was recognized as the 'Most Outstanding Start-Up CEO' at the 2024 Ghana CEO Awards.

name: MegaQuest
description: A voice-first research platform that helps you collect rich, authentic audio responses and transform them into actionable, AI-driven insights in multiple languages.

founders.name: Francis Val-Neboh
founders.bio: Francis is an award-winning tech entrepreneur and AI integration specialist. He leads MegaQuest in utilizing AI-driven insights to scale qualitative research.

name: BitSpenda
description: A cryptocurrency exchange platform that lets users buy and sell Bitcoin seamlessly using mobile money — bridging crypto and everyday payments in Ghana.

founders.name: Bright Kportiklah
founders.bio: Bright is a software engineer and Bitcoin developer recognized for his contributions to grassroots Bitcoin adoption in Africa. He also serves as a technical advisor for Bitcoin Dua.

name: STACX
description: The content creator CRM built for influencers — manage brand deals, track payments and invoices, organize deliverables, and grow your creator income from one clean dashboard.

founders.name: Desmond Ofori Appiah
founders.bio: Known as Dessy Ocean, Desmond is a prominent tech content creator and entrepreneur in Ghana. He built STACX to solve the administrative challenges faced by the creator economy.

name: Phundit
description: A guided savings platform that helps you build your emergency fund step by step — save consistently, grow your money with interest, and earn rewards for your progress.

founders.name: Peter Tokor
founders.bio: Peter is an entrepreneur and systems thinker with a background in Renewable Energy Engineering. Before Phundit, he co-founded Airrandz, a last-mile logistics company.

name: BoostMate
description: An ambassador marketing platform that helps brands connect with passionate advocates, launch campaigns, and amplify reach organically through authentic connections.

founders.name: Augusta Addy
founders.bio: Augusta co-founded BoostMate after participating in the MEST Africa incubation program. She previously worked in the startup ecosystem as an Experience Lead at Heny.

name: Speso
description: A next-gen super app for everyday payments — send money to friends and family quickly across banks and mobile money, and discover other services through mini apps.

name: BMPT Books
description: A cloud accounting platform for businesses — manage invoicing, expenses, payroll, inventory, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting from anywhere, on any device.

founders.name: Charles Yeboah Frimpong
founders.bio: Charles is an entrepreneur associated with BMPT Solutions and serves as a Director for BMPT Books. He also maintains a long-standing role at Ishmael Yamson & Associates.

founders.name: Kingsley Adu-wiredu
founders.bio: Kingsley frequently partners with Charles Yeboah Frimpong in managing and promoting BMPT Books as an accounting software platform for small businesses.
